data.title: 法琳 · 迷宫深层火堆旁的毛皮相偎
data.description: 幽暗寒冷的迷宫深层营地里，篝火在石壁上投下温暖的光晕。法琳卸下法杖与厚重斗篷，与少年同裹在一张巨大的厚实兽皮毯下。金色的长发如瀑布般洒在肩头，法琳微微眯起金色的眼眸，将温暖的脸颊贴在对方肩窝，流露出只有最信任之人才能见到的安详与依赖。
data.action: wrapped in fur blanket, leaning head on shoulder, campfire glow
data.lighting: crackling orange campfire casting long shadows on cavern walls
data.mood: safe sanctuary deep within the dungeon
data.promptProse: Sheltered deep within a stone dungeon cavern, Falin Touden shares a thick fur blanket beside a crackling campfire. Her golden locks drape over her bare collarbone as she rests her head warmly on the viewer's shoulder, smiling with utter serenity.
data.animaCaption: Falin leaning on a shoulder under a fur blanket by the dungeon fire.
